page_title: Zielzeit: when will my portfolio reach my goal?

summary.name: Zielzeit
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows when a Scalable Capital portfolio is projected to reach a goal, read through the official Scalable CLI.
use_cases: See when your Scalable Capital portfolio is likely to reach a savings goal
Check portfolio progress from the macOS menu bar without opening a broker app
Test how saving more per month changes your goal arrival date
Review holdings and returns expressed as time gained toward a goal
Audit a read-only investing tool before installing it
summary.what_it_does: Zielzeit is a macOS menu bar app that answers when a user's Scalable Capital portfolio will reach a chosen goal. It reads account data through the official Scalable CLI using five allowlisted read-only commands (overview, savings-plans, transactions, holdings, whoami). The Forecast view compares the user's actual pace with cautious and moderate scenarios. The What if view lets users adjust a savings slider or pick a target year to see the monthly amount needed. The Holdings view expresses each position's returns as weeks closer to the goal. The app is available in five languages: English, Deutsch, Français, Español and Italiano.
notable: Read-only: five read commands and no write commands, checked by a `make audit` script against the source
No networking code in the app; figures go from the official CLI to the popover
Installs via Homebrew cask and works on Apple silicon and Intel
caveats: Requires macOS 15 or later and the official Scalable CLI, plus Agentic Investing enabled in the Scalable account
Signed but not notarized, so the user must approve it once via Privacy & Security → Open Anyway
Portfolio data is forgotten on quit; only goal, language and CLI access flag are stored
